ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs, and authorized signatories against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, UN Consolidated Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the RMI domestic sanctions/terrorist designations. Enhanced due diligence is required for politically exposed persons with documented source of funds and source of wealth. Customer due diligence follows FATF Recommendation 10 and the RMI FIU Directive, including risk-based ongoing monitoring.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Registrar of Corporations — Corporate Name Reservation Unit (direct electronic filing is available only through licensed Marshall Islands Registered Agents; no unrestricted public online portal is operated by the Registry)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in English, or in Latin script transliteration for Marshallese or foreign words. The name must include a corporate designator such as 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', or their abbreviations. There is no mandatory local-script filing requirement; diacritical marks may be omitted for ASCII compatibility.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be extended once for an additional 90 days by written request filed with the Registrar before expiration, accompanied by the extension fee. If the name is rejected, the applicant must file a written Request for Name Review with the Registrar within 14 business days of the rejection notice, stating the basis of objection and proposing either a distinguishing element or consent from the holder of a similar name. The Registrar must issue a written decision within 7 business days. Further refusal may be appealed administratively to the Minister with delegated corporate registry authority within 21 calendar days, and thereafter to the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands. Rejection does not refund the name reservation fee; a new application and fee are required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Remote and virtual back-office operations are acceptable for a non-resident business corporation engaged in automated subtitle transcription and AI voice cloning. No separate local physical office is statutorily required. The company must maintain a registered agent with a physical office in the Marshall Islands, which may serve as the company's registered office. No additional economic substance physical footprint is triggered for ISIC 5912 post-production services unless the activity includes holding or licensing intellectual property generating royalty income; in that case, the RMI Economic Substance Regulations 2018 may impose a physical presence and IP substance test.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — under 5% annual likelihood for a non-licensed, low-risk non-resident company in the film post-production industry; unannounced inspections are risk-based and generally focus on registered agent compliance, AML/CFT obligations, and economic substance filing accuracy.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act, Title 24 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code (1990, as amended) (the 'BCA'); operative provisions on Articles of Incorporation, registered agent and registered office, initial directors, officers, and corporate maintenance.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands; filing submissions are delivered exclusively through a licensed Marshall Islands registered agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (BCA-form) as endorsed by the Registrar; evidenced by the Certificate of Incorporation and certified registry extracts.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital, share premium, or escrow deposit is required under the BCA. Authorized capital may consist of zero-par-value common shares; fully paid shares may be issued for cash, contributed technology assets, or goodwill. Foreign ownership and non-resident shareholders are expressly permitted.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLVED, that the Corporation's authorized Common Shares, as set out in the Articles of Incorporation, are subscribed and issued to the founding shareholder in full consideration of contributed technology assets, with no minimum paid-in and no escrow required under Title 24 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code.

RESOLVED, that the registered office and licensed registered agent are confirmed; that the officers be appointed as President, Secretary, and Treasurer; and that the corporate payment platform mandate is ratified, authorizing Stripe and Wise accounts.

RESOLVED, that the President is directed to execute all corporate instruments, open bank accounts, and maintain corporate records.

RESOLVED, that the Corporation's Bylaws are adopted, and this action is effective nunc pro tunc from incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Registered Agent Appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (name reservation desk); engagement of an RMI-licensed registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the registered agent to run a pre-clearance name search through the Registry index; reserve the corporate name (containing 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', or an approved abbreviation) for an initial period of 30 days; simultaneously execute the agent engagement letter designating the agent's Majuro street address as the registered office.
required_dossiers: Name Reservation Request signed by the incorporator
Registered Agent Consent and Designation with the agent's statutory acceptance
Agent engagement letter and corporate due diligence questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry marks the name as confusingly similar or reserved, promptly file a replacement reservation with two alternate names or submit the affected party's written consent; the amended reservation is processed within one business day at a nominal replacement fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Execution, and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator and initial director; notarization by an RMI-licensed notary or by a foreign notary with apostille for remote signatures; the registered agent coordinates execution logistics.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft Articles of Incorporation containing: the corporate name; the registered agent and office; a lawful purpose covering post-production subtitle transcription and AI voice technologies; the capital structure of 2,000,000 zero-par-value common shares; the names and addresses of the initial directors; and the permitted indemnification and voting provisions. Execute in counterparts, notarize or legalize signer capacity, and forward the executed set to the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Articles of Incorporation (executed and notarized or apostilled)
Written consent of incorporator naming the initial directors
Notarial certificate or apostille where executed outside the RMI
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry raises a formatting or legal-capacity defect, file Articles of Correction or a corrective amendment; a defective notarial page is cured by re-execution before the same notary within one business day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Articles and Payment of State Filing Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (document intake and fee counter); payment by wire, bank draft, or the registered agent's trust account.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver the executed Articles and notarial pages to the Registrar through the registered agent, together with a fee cover sheet and remittance of US$200 plus agent disbursements. Obtain the Registry's entry stamp and corporate number; the Registrar either files the Articles or issues a query notice for correction.
required_dossiers: Executed Articles of Incorporation
Fee remittance record (wire confirmation or agent check stub)
Transmittal letter confirming exempt non-resident status and intended digital services
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A Registry query defaults after 30 days; cure by filing the requested corrective page or amendment with an explanatory letter. A rejection may be lifted by an administrative reconsideration request addressed to the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Certified Registry Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (certification division).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon filing, request the Certificate of Incorporation, an endorsed copy of the Articles, and a Certificate of Good Standing issued no earlier than 30 days before presentation for banking or payment-platform onboarding. The registered agent acknowledges receipt and enters the incorporation date in the corporate register.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Certified copy of the Articles of Incorporation
Certificate of Good Standing (issued within 30 days)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For typographical or legal-date errors in the Certificate, return the original for a Registrar correction memorandum; expedited re-issuance is available on payment of the applicable certificate re-issue fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Action: Bylaws, Officers, Bank Mandate, and First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Initial directors named in the Articles; action by unanimous written consent or a duly convened organizational meeting.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt the Bylaws; appoint the President, Secretary, and Treasurer; confirm the registered office and agent; ratify the pro-forma First Board Resolution; and authorize opening of Stripe and Wise settlement accounts, including the corporate mandate and signatories' specimen signatures.
required_dossiers: Waiver of notice or organizational meeting minutes
Bylaws (Secretary-certified copy)
First Board Resolution as set out in the incorporation legal framework
Officer appointment and acceptance forms
Share subscription schedule and associated consents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a required consent is unsigned, cure by a subsequent unanimous written consent ratifying the prior action, including nunc pro tunc effectiveness where permitted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Register, Share Certificates, and Continuing Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate Secretary and licensed registered agent; Registry acceptance of continuing annual obligations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the share certificate book, members' register, transfers register, and minutes book; issue and seal the founder share certificates if the Bylaws require a corporate seal; and instruct the registered agent to monitor the annual report and franchise-tax cycle to prevent administrative revocation.
required_dossiers: Share certificate counterfoils and stock ledger
Statutory registers of members, directors, and secretary
Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing filed in the minute book
Annual report and franchise tax compliance calendar
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Failure to meet an annual deadline is cured by payment of arrears and a reinstatement application to the Registrar, supported by a certificate of the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax-Exempt Confirmation and KYC Onboarding to Payment Rails
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RMI Ministry of Finance / Office of Tax Administration; Stripe and Wise compliance teams as regulated payment institutions; registered agent certification support.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the exemption declaration confirming no local-source income for the non-resident digital services company; then complete Stripe and Wise merchant onboarding by submitting the corporate pack, beneficial-ownership declaration, officer passports, and a narrative of the AI-dubbing and subtitle-transcription business model to satisfy AML screening.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing dated within 30 days
Beneficial Ownership Declaration and register excerpt
Articles of Incorporation (certified)
Directors' and officers' passports, proof of address, and background questionnaire
Bank reference letter (if requested)
Tax-exempt status declaration cover letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a payment rail declines, respond with an enhanced due diligence pack, source-of-funds evidence, and a synthetic-voice consent and disclosure policy; an appeal may be filed with the payment institution's compliance officer, or an alternative payment rail may be engaged.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing board is engaged for this digital, non-resident post-production studio. The Foreign Investment Business Act applies only if the corporation establishes a physical place of business in the RMI; the RMI Telecommunications Authority treats cloud-based subtitle and AI processing as an exempt information-transmission service. Local business license and zoning permits arise only upon a subsequent physical soundstage or office execution.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable - statutory license exempt under the composite key's requires_statutory_license flag. If physical premises in Majuro are later added: Municipal Business License under the Local Government Act and, for non-citizen controlled entities, a Foreign Investment Business License under the Foreign Investment Business Act.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Agency of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMIEPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration-level screening with no full EIA report required, because operations are intangible digital services. RMIEPA Form 110 registration is triggered only if a physical studio or warehouse exceeds 500 square meters or stationary diesel generation exceeds 50 kVA.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Negligible point-source discharge: any wash-water or cooling-water output must meet RMIEPA National Water Quality Standards (pH 6.0-8.5; total suspended solids less than or equal to 30 mg/L; BOD5 less than or equal to 5 mg/L). E-waste flows from obsolete GPU/AI servers, lithium batteries, and subtitle equipment must be manifested to certified recyclers under the Waste Management Regulations; any imported solvents or adhesive-cleaning materials must comply with the RMIEPA solvent-management standard of not more than 0.6% VOC content by weight.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate of Fitness from the RMI Fire Department after inspection of electrical, battery-storage, and server-rack areas; structural load review for any raised floor or data vault; occupational workplace clearance under the Worker Rights Act and the RMI Health and Safety Code, including hearing conservation for mastering rooms, ergonomic AI-monitor lighting, and heat-stress controls for staffed technical rooms.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: No national corporate income tax, VAT, or general sales tax administration exists in the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI). The operative statutory body for the non-resident Business Corporation is the Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro, operating under the Business Corporations Act, 1990. Indirect levies on physical imports are administered by the Marshall Islands Customs Service, Ministry of Finance. Wage tax and social security, if local employees are engaged, are administered by the Marshall Islands Social Security Administration. The Foreign Investment Policy Act, 1990 is administered by the Office of the Chief Executive Officer, Marshall Islands Development Fund / FIBL unit.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident Business Corporation is not issued a tax identification number (TIN) because the RMI imposes no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, estate tax, gift tax, VAT, GST, or sales and use tax on non-resident corporations. The statutory identity credentials are: (i) Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar of Corporations under the Business Corporations Act; (ii) the company registration number appearing on the certificate; and (iii) a Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL) required for any business with non-resident ownership conducting or contemplating business in the RMI under the Foreign Investment Policy Act, 1990. If the entity imports physical equipment or goods into the RMI, it must obtain a Customs importer registration from the Marshall Islands Customs Service. If it hires RMI-based employees, it must register with the Marshall Islands Social Security Administration for wage tax withholding and social security contributions; this is the only situation in which a tax-related filing number is generated. No other national registration is required for the conduct of offshore post-production services.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None applicable. The RMI has no domestic corporate income tax statute and therefore no check-the-box, transparency election, or hybrid mismatch election is available under RMI law. Tax-exempt status is automatic and mandatory for a Business Corporation recognizing itself as non-resident within the meaning of the Business Corporations Act, 1990. The U.S.-RMI income tax treaty does not create taxing jurisdiction over the non-resident corporation and no treaty election is required. The entity may, however, voluntarily elect to file consolidated foreign reporting or maintain internal tax classification for the benefit of foreign parent reporting jurisdictions, but such elections are contractual/administrative and do not affect RMI taxation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None — the Republic of the Marshall Islands imposes no VAT, no GST, and no sales and use tax. The only indirect levy is an import duty (customs tariff) applied to tangible goods entering RMI territory; offshore digital services such as automated subtitle transcription and AI voice cloning are outside the indirect tax nexus entirely.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT/GST registration threshold exists because no value-added or general consumption tax is enacted. Import duty registration arises per transaction, not upon a turnover threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Not applicable — the RMI operates no real-time fiscal clearance system, no mandatory e-invoicing or API-based reporting, no digital stamping regime, and no continuous transaction control (CTC) framework. Customs import entries are processed on paper or through licensed customs brokers. Electronic invoicing, if used commercially, remains voluntary and purely contractual.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable as a tax concept. Because the RMI has no VAT/GST/sales tax, there is no export zero-rating mechanism and no refundable input tax. Subtitle transcription and AI voice cloning services supplied by the non-resident Business Corporation from outside RMI to foreign customers are entirely outside the RMI indirect tax net, regardless of customer location, supply chain platform, or payment rail. As a policy matter, the entity can invoice customers without any RMI tax add-on, and no export approval is required from the RMI tax authorities.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Not applicable for VAT refund purposes. For any physical consignment of goods out of the RMI, a Marshall Islands Export Declaration or domestic air/sea waybill may be required by the Marshall Islands Customs Service; a Bill of Lading or Air Waybill is customary. An Inward Remittance Certificate is not a statutory requirement because the RMI imposes no foreign exchange controls and provides no VAT refund substantiation procedure. For the pure digital service model, no customs or remittance documentation is mandated.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Not applicable in the tax sense. With no VAT system in the RMI, there is no statutory clawback of export zero-rating and no penal framework for fraudulent export VAT refund claims. The material compliance risks are: (i) under the Customs Act, any false statement in a physical export declaration is punishable by fines, forfeiture, and potential criminal liability; (ii) conducting any RMI-resident business without a valid Foreign Investment Business License may result in daily fines and license revocation; (iii) failure to appoint or maintain a Registrar-approved registered agent in the RMI exposes the corporation to administrative dissolution; and (iv) although the RMI has no mandatory 180-day FX repatriation deadline and payments may flow freely through Stripe or Wise, the 180-day benchmark may be contractually required by foreign financing partners or intercompany agreements, and failure to document the transaction chain may expose the ultimate foreign parent to unrelated anti-money-laundering or transfer-pricing audit risk in the parent's jurisdiction.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (exercising prudential supervision under the Banking Act 1991; there is no domestic central bank, and the U.S. Federal Reserve serves as the de facto issuer of the U.S. dollar, the sole legal tender).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) has adopted the U.S. dollar as its exclusive legal tender and maintains no exchange-control regime on capital or current account transactions. Dividends, profit remittances, and royalty outflows of non-resident Business Corporations are fully convertible and require no central bank approval or repatriation tax. Current account and capital account transactions are unrestricted; commercial banks apply only standard AML/CTF due diligence and correspondent-bank compliance screening, which may require documentary substantiation of source of funds but does not impose convertibility barriers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender timelines or mandatory conversion ratios apply because the U.S. dollar is the domestic currency and RMI imposes no foreign-exchange surrender regime. Licensed banks are not required to convert or surrender any portion of export trade proceeds to the government; the entity retains 100% of export receipts, including revenue from AI subtitle transcription and voice-cloning services.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Moderate, subject to jurisdictional licensing constraints. RMI does not issue electronic money institution (EMI) or e-money licences; digital payment providers such as Stripe and Wise generally onboard RMI-incorporated entities only through U.S., U.K., or E.U. licensed acquiring partners. The low-risk classification of the AI post-production business and the selection of Stripe and Wise as target rails improve viability, but offshore EMIs may decline onboarding where the entity lacks physical substance or regional presence. Recommended structure: operate through a U.S. or Hong Kong-supported payment corridor, use a U.S.-EIN-linked Stripe Business account, and use Wise Business for low-value contractor disbursements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: RMI banks and their U.S. correspondent banks generally require an in-person interview for corporate account opening; at least one director or authorised signatory must appear physically at a Bank of Marshall Islands or Bank of Guam office in Majuro, Ebon, or a designated correspondent/consular location, though remote video KYC is occasionally accepted on an exception basis. Required documents include certified articles of incorporation, certificate of incumbency from the registered agent, notarised passports and proof of residential address for all directors/shareholders, a board resolution authorising account opening, and a business plan evidencing the AI subtitle and dubbing operation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bearer share issuance risk under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified share register extract and registered agent certificate confirming no bearer or inscribed shares; legal opinion confirming the articles of incorporation prohibit bearer instruments; Annual Filing Certificate evidencing good standing with the RMI Registrar of Corporations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ownership and absence of physical operations in RMI
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incumbency from the registered agent; notarised passports and proof of residence for all shareholders and directors; shareholder capital injection proof; audited or accountant-reviewed financial statements; executed client contracts evidencing genuine AI subtitle transcription and voice-cloning commercial activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Correspondent-bank flags arising from RMI crypto and DAO legislative association
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Compliance narrative confirming no digital-asset issuance, wallet, staking, or DAO registration; fiat-only transaction ledger or trial balance; certified corporate chart demonstrating conventional board control; statutory agent declaration of no DLT activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity cross-border inflows via EMI aggregators (Stripe/Wise) and source-of-funds scrutiny
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Stripe and Wise settlement statements matched to issued invoices; beneficial ownership declaration filed under the RMI beneficial ownership register; treasury policy memo projecting monthly volumes and counterparty jurisdictions; service-level agreements with dubbing clients substantiating payment spikes.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: USD-only SWIFT MT103 wire transfers routed through the RMI bank's U.S. correspondent account using the purpose code for corporate capital contribution (FEDWIRE/CHIPS, reference code 'Corporate Capital Contribution'); the initial deposit must be accompanied by a board resolution, certificate of good standing, and notarised source-of-funds statement. RMI imposes no capital-import approval, stamp duty, or exchange-control filing. An initial injection at or above the bank's USD 10,000–50,000 operational minimum is recommended to avoid an undercapitalisation flag.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Three-tier clearing architecture: (i) SWIFT MT103 transfers from the RMI operational account via the U.S. correspondent for voice talent, subtitle editors, and software/cloud vendors; (ii) commercial documentary letters of credit under UCP600 for high-value procurement of licensing and equipment; and (iii) Wise Business and Stripe Connect payouts for low-value, high-frequency disbursements to freelancers in Asia-Pacific and EU corridors. Every outbound wire must bear accurate purpose codes reflecting service fees or royalties, with FATCA/CRS self-certifications maintained current.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Offshore plain-vanilla USD/EUR and USD/GBP FX forwards executed with licensed U.S. or U.K. dealers to hedge Stripe payout conversion exposure
Cross-currency swaps on AI licensing receivables denominated in EUR or JPY, subject to a board-approved treasury policy and non-speculative mandate
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on exotic corridor currencies (KRW, THB, VND) for subcontractor disbursement hedging, priced via Hong Kong/Singapore-based venues
Short-dated FX forward ladders covering no more than 12x expected monthly settlement exposure, prohibited for speculative trading under the internal treasury mandate

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before April 30; filing window is January 1 through April 30 each year for the preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of US$25 (10% of standard annual report fee) for submissions after April 30; failure to file for three consecutive years triggers administrative dissolution and strike-off from the Corporate Registry; reinstatement requires payment of all outstanding fees and penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Continuation Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous annual obligation aligned with the April 30 annual report deadline; agent appointment must be renewed and evidenced during each annual filing cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a licensed Marshall Islands registered agent and registered office constitutes grounds for involuntary administrative dissolution under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is mandated for a non-resident, non-publicly-traded Business Corporation engaged in subtitle transcription and AI voice cloning services. A compulsory independent audit is triggered only by a written demand from shareholders holding at least 10% of the outstanding voting shares under Section 92 of the Business Corporations Act, or by the terms of a financing, licensing, or regulatory agreement.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB is the primary acceptable framework; US GAAP is also accepted for statutory books and internal financial statements. No financial statements are filed with the Registrar, and audited accounts are not publicly lodged.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Marshall Islands maintains no public UBO registry. The corporation must keep a complete Register of Members and Register of Directors at its registered office or principal business address in the Marshall Islands. Each share transfer must be recorded in the share ledger promptly upon registration, and each annual corporate report must confirm the current directors, officers, and share capital structure as of the filing date.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Shareholder and Director Meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$1,500–US$3,500 per engagement if audit is triggered

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (non-resident domestic Business Corporation statutory exemption under the Business Corporations Act and the Income Tax Act 1990; no corporate income tax is levied on income lacking Marshall Islands source)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption from Marshall Islands income tax, capital gains tax, franchise tax and branch remittance tax; the only recurring charge is the flat annual government registration fee payable to the RMI Corporate Registry

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return is required for a non-resident Business Corporation. The sole mandatory annual filing is the Annual Report and Annual Government Fee Return (Registry Form 1) submitted by the licensed registered agent through the RMI Corporate Registry e-filing portal administered by the Registrar of Corporations.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on 31 March of each year in respect of the preceding calendar year; the registered agent must file the return together with the statutory annual government fee.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name, certificate or registration number, and the non-resident domestic corporation status election marker.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the name precisely as registered and confirm the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation status to preserve the zero-rate tax exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Address of the registered office maintained in the Republic of the Marshall Islands by the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the registered agent's office address in Majuro; a local service address is mandatory even for a fully non-resident entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and licence number of the Marshall Islands registered agent authorised to accept service of process.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident filers must appoint and continuously maintain a licensed RMI registered agent for all registry filings and fee payments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses and nationalities of all incumbent directors and officers of the corporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be non-resident individuals and no local residency requirement applies; the agent must affirm the directors' capacity and identity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Members and Beneficial Ownership Register Confirmation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the register of members, including the record of ultimate beneficial owners, is maintained and available to the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The register may be kept outside the RMI, but a copy must be delivered to the registered office; confirm retention of complete KYC and AML documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculation of the flat annual government fee applicable to a non-resident domestic corporation, inclusive of any surcharge.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare the non-resident election and pay the statutory fee; no declaration of RMI-source income is required for exempt non-resident entities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late submission attracts a statutory late charge (generally 10% of the annual government fee) plus accruing interest on arrears; continued default triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution of the corporation, with reinstatement conditioned on payment of arrears, penalties and a reinstatement fee.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - the Marshall Islands imposes no dividend withholding tax, no branch profits tax and no gross-receipts tax on distributions made by a non-resident domestic corporation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The RMI has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network; the principal international arrangement is the U.S.-RMI Tax Information Exchange Agreement (2002). Because the domestic statutory withholding rate is already zero, treaty relief is superfluous for inbound RMI-source payments; an outbound investor claiming foreign tax credit relief in its home jurisdiction must request an RMI certificate of non-assessment or residency certificate from the RMI Ministry of Finance Tax Division, supported by the registered agent's confirmation of exempt non-resident status.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax on cross-border royalties for IP and on debt interest paid to non-residents: 0%. Treaty rates: not applicable due to the absence of comprehensive DTAs; the payer must retain documentary evidence of beneficial ownership of the income stream.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - the Marshall Islands (whose official currency is the U.S. dollar) has no statutory transfer pricing regime and enacts no Local File or Master File documentation thresholds; multinational groups operating the subtitle transcription and AI voice cloning studio prepare OECD-aligned transfer pricing documentation solely to satisfy the TP statutes of counterpart jurisdictions such as the United States (IRC Section 482).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI has adopted Economic Substance Regulations aligned with OECD harmful tax practice standards for geographically mobile activities. For an audio dubbing and automated subtitle studio, the core activity constitutes a service business; any local RMI management, local staff, or locally booked contracts would trigger an economic substance filing, audited accounts and substance attestation with the RMI Tax Division. A purely non-resident BC that executes contracts offshore, with no local premises, no local employees and no local decision-making, avoids the ESR filing obligation but must maintain documented evidence of offshore management and control.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Conducting an actual RMI-source business from within the Marshall Islands while falsely maintaining non-resident domestic corporation status, or understating gross revenue attributable to RMI clients to retain the zero-rate exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reclassification as a resident domestic corporation subject to income tax on worldwide income; back-assessment of tax plus interest; a penalty of up to 100% of underpaid tax; and criminal prosecution for tax evasion with statutory fines and a term of imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false exemption declarations are personally liable for the tax deficiency; courts may pierce the corporate veil to order civil restitution, impose travel bans and passport surrender to secure the investigation, and impose imprisonment for evasion and false oath.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the BC as a nominee shell with no business purpose, no substance, no board minutes, and no registered office beyond the agent's address while booking substantial subtitle and AI voice cloning service revenue through the entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalties under the Economic Substance Regulations for non-compliance; administrative strike-off of the corporation; and loss of the non-resident tax exemption if local management is found to exist in the RMI.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false economic substance declarations face fines and imprisonment; nominee and shadow-directorship arrangements expose the actors to personal liability for fraudulent trading and to confiscation of proceeds.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure of the registered agent and directors to maintain the principal register of members, identify the ultimate beneficial owner, or report suspicious transactions connected to the AI studio, including high-volume cross-border payments routed through Stripe and Wise that obscure counterparty identity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil fines and administrative penalties under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act; regulatory action against the registered agent; referral to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit; and termination of correspondent banking relationships.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners are jointly and severally liable for AML fines; repeated breaches attract personal criminal liability, travel restrictions to prevent asset dissipation, and civil forfeiture of the proceeds of the unlawful activity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the Annual Report and pay the annual government fee by 31 March, or submission of materially false details regarding directors, members or beneficial owners.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Statutory late penalty plus interest; after continued default the Registrar strikes the corporation off the register, the entity is dissolved, and it loses legal capacity, bank accounts and payment rail access.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Continued trading after strike-off renders directors personally liable for the company's obligations; restoration costs and imprisonment for misrepresentation in registry filings may also be imposed.
